```{python}
#| label: fig-median-vs-mean-welfare
#| fig-cap: 'Welfare Aggregation Under Skewed Preferences. When preference distributions are right-skewed (common in health/safety domains), median-based aggregation (RepDem) fails minorities with intense needs. Mean-based aggregation (RAPPA) achieves higher total welfare by respecting preference intensity.'
#| echo: false
#| output: false

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle
from dih_models.plotting.chart_style import (
    setup_chart_style,
    add_watermark,
    save_figure_with_margins,
    get_figure_output_path
)

# Apply consistent style

setup_chart_style()
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))

# Generate right-skewed distribution (lognormal) representing health needs

np.random.seed(42)
needs = np.random.lognormal(mean=1.5, sigma=1.2, size=1000)
needs = np.clip(needs, 0, 50)  # Clip extreme outliers

# Calculate median and mean

median_need = np.median(needs)
mean_need = np.mean(needs)

# Create histogram

counts, bins, patches = ax.hist(needs, bins=40, alpha=0.6, color='steelblue', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5)

# Highlight median vs mean regions

ax.axvline(median_need, color='red', linestyle='--', linewidth=2.5, label=f'Median (RepDem): {median_need:.1f}\n(Ignores tail risk)', zorder=5)
ax.axvline(mean_need, color='green', linestyle='--', linewidth=2.5, label=f'Mean (RAPPA): {mean_need:.1f}\n(Respects intensity)', zorder=5)

# Shade the tail region (those with intense needs)

tail_threshold = np.percentile(needs, 75)
ax.axvspan(tail_threshold, 50, alpha=0.2, color='red', label='High-Need Minority\n(Underserved by Median)')

# Labels and title

ax.set_xlabel('Intensity of Need (e.g., DALYs, healthcare priority)', fontsize=11)
ax.set_ylabel('Number of Citizens', fontsize=11)
ax.set_title('Median Voter Theorem Fails Under Preference Skewness', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax.legend(loc='upper right', fontsize=9)

# Add annotations

ax.annotate(
    'Median ignores\nintense minorities',
    xy=(median_need, max(counts) * 0.8),
    xytext=(median_need - 5, max(counts) * 0.9),
    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='red', lw=1.5),
    fontsize=9,
    color='red',
    ha='right'
)

ax.annotate(
    'Mean captures\npreference intensity',
    xy=(mean_need, max(counts) * 0.6),
    xytext=(mean_need + 5, max(counts) * 0.7),
    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='green', lw=1.5),
    fontsize=9,
    color='green',
    ha='left'
)

ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3, linestyle=':', linewidth=0.5)
plt.tight_layout()

# Add watermark and save

add_watermark(fig)
output_path = get_figure_output_path('rappa-median-vs-mean-welfare.png')
save_figure_with_margins(fig, output_path)
```
